question: Train on high gas concentrations from other devices, identify low-concentration CO and alternative gases on unseen device

datasets.name: UCI 251, Gas sensor arrays in open sampling settings
datasets.decision: Reject as independent CO gas-identification confirmation
datasets.reason: An independent audit found gas species measured in temporally clustered batches; even the pre-release sensor response predicts the gas. Its minimally drift-contaminated subset contains methanol, ethylene and butanol, not CO. The low nominal source level is 1000 ppm and is not a low ambient concentration at the sensor.
datasets.note: An earlier project stage used only a methane subset for an unrelated task; this is not the entire UCI 251 archive.

datasets.name: Chongqing University E-nose drift analysis dataset
datasets.decision: Independent cross-board mechanism stress only
datasets.reason: Published archive maps label integers to neither named gases nor sample concentrations; CO and high-to-low transfer cannot be asserted. Frozen amplitude stress test failed in both board directions.

datasets.name: Solorzano et al., Multi-unit calibration rejects inherent device variability
datasets.decision: Ideal independent design, raw measurements not located in public publication/repository record
datasets.reason: The paper describes five devices exposed to six named gases and air across concentration and humidity settings, but the accessible university repository lists only the paper PDF.

datasets.name: UCI gas sensor array low-concentration (Chinese group)
datasets.decision: Ineligible for cross-device CO validation
datasets.reason: Single sensor array; six VOCs do not include CO; levels are all 50-200 ppb.

datasets.name: Zenodo 6821340 Transfer Learning Dataset for Metal Oxide Semiconductor Gas Sensors
datasets.decision: Independent paired cross-sensor CO concentration regression stress only; ineligible for CO present versus absent identification
datasets.reason: Zenodo metadata gives the CO range as 100–2000 ppb for every one of three mixture batches; all samples contain CO. Sensors A/B/C were measured simultaneously with aligned targets, but the classification target CO versus no CO is unidentifiable.

datasets.name: DS-PS pure substances, Zenodo 19557093
datasets.decision: Not eligible for CO cross-device validation
datasets.reason: Three analytes are ethanol, acetone and butanone; the 12 sensor replicas are redundant channels of a single array, and no CO exposure class is documented. Seven concentrations and randomized repetitions do not create independent devices.

datasets.name: Dalian Maritime University synergetic laser-electronic sensor array, Mendeley 2mpx85xt6g and sdh7x7b68d
datasets.decision: Not an independent additional dataset and not multi-device
datasets.reason: Same six listed authors, experimental schedule 50 s baseline + 200 s gas + recovery, CH4/CO/H2S ranges, and exactly 186 data points as the already tested mixture pilot. A second Mendeley record does not add 186 independent experiments; the data describe one sensor array, not physical target devices.

datasets.name: Chinese bionic olfaction CO/H2 dataset (Acta Automatica Sinica 2024)
datasets.decision: Paper identified, no eligible publicly downloadable multi-device dataset confirmed
datasets.reason: Paper reports 352 response recordings including 117 CO, 115 H2 and 120 CO+H2; no independent devices or public raw-download link established from source.

datasets.name: Rapid Detection of Mixed Gases from Lithium Battery Thermal Runaway (Batteries 2026)
datasets.decision: Cannot be used as public independent validation
datasets.reason: Authors state data can be shared upon request, not a public raw download; their UCI Twin external experiment reuses the inspected original archive.

datasets.name: Indoor Fire Dataset with Distributed Multi-Sensor Nodes, Mendeley npk2zcm85h
datasets.decision: Ineligible for controlled CO gas identity and high-to-low validation
datasets.reason: Public data contain repeated fire and nuisance events with distributed nodes and a CO sensor reading, but labels are scenario/fire/nuisance, not independently measured CO-present/absent gas identity or controlled CO concentration. A row is a 10-second node reading; 305304 rows are not independent gas exposures.

datasets.name: MetaSense multi-site multi-unit ambient pollution dataset
datasets.decision: Ineligible for CO response target validation
datasets.reason: Boards record CO electrochemical voltage, but the accompanying 2019 transfer study supplies reference concentrations and fits targets only for NO2 and O3. The authors state reference data were minute-averaged NO2 and O3; CO voltage is an input feature, not a CO ground truth.

datasets.name: UCI 487 Gas sensor array temperature modulation
datasets.decision: Not independent blind data or CO versus other gas experiment
datasets.reason: This project already fitted CO regression on this archive. It has seven physical replicas per sensor type and 0-20 ppm CO, but the only other variable is humidity, not alternative gases.

datasets.name: UCI 322 gas sensor array under dynamic gas mixtures
datasets.decision: Not independent device-level experimental replication
datasets.reason: Four units per sensor type are channels on a single array, recorded in one continuous 12-hour run per mixture. Arbitrary windows cannot constitute independent gas exposure trials.

datasets.name: Indoor Fire Dataset with Distributed Multi-Sensor Nodes
datasets.decision: Ineligible for CO species validation
datasets.reason: Distributed sensor nodes measure CO alongside CO2, H2, humidity, PM, temperature and UV, but labels are fire/nuisance/background events, with no controlled CO concentrations or CO-present versus other-gas ground truth. Time rows are not independent exposures.

datasets.name: MetaSense multi-site air pollution network
datasets.decision: Ineligible for CO response target
datasets.reason: Multiple devices include CO electrode signals, but the published colocation references and regression targets are NO2 and O3 only. CO voltage is an input feature, not a reference CO label.

datasets.name: UCI 322 dynamic gas mixtures
datasets.decision: No independent exposure replication
datasets.reason: Four units per sensor type are channels in one array; each mixture is one continuous approximately 12-hour run. Window rows cannot support independent-device/exposure inference.

datasets.name: RED:Vapor wind tunnel dataset (Scientific Data 2026)
datasets.decision: No CO exposure
datasets.reason: 39 runs use an ethanol/propylene glycol/triethylene glycol/water fog source and purging periods; physical multiple sensors cannot yield CO present-versus-absent ground truth.

datasets.name: Kang et al. 2022 batch-uniform gas sensor array supplementary data
datasets.decision: No eligible public held-device mixed-gas exposure dataset confirmed
datasets.reason: Article covers CO, NH3, NO2, CH4, acetone, and air classification on fabricated arrays, but the public Figshare item is article supporting information, not an indexed raw held-device CO/no-CO mixture dataset. The 2022 CNN result is prior art for multi-gas recognition.

datasets.name: Samsung DS2 Kaggle gas sensor competition
datasets.decision: Duplicate UCI dynamic-mixture source
datasets.reason: Competition description identifies the 16-channel ethylene/CO time series already present in the UCI dynamic gas mixtures family; no separate target devices.

datasets.name: Solorzano et al. 2022 early-fire dataset Zenodo 5707399
datasets.decision: No controlled CO species label
datasets.reason: Public raw array data are from fire and nuisance experiments in a standard fire room. Exposure labels are fire/nuisance scenarios, not independently dosed CO present/absent and concentration pairs across devices.

datasets.name: 2010 Montoliu et al. CO/CH4 MCR-ALS mixture study
datasets.decision: No public raw held-device dataset located
datasets.reason: CO and methane mixtures in dry air were measured for curve resolution, but neither replicated target devices nor downloadable raw trials were identified.

datasets.name: 国家基础学科公共科学数据中心：气体传感器芯片设计模拟数据和制造工艺试验数据和测试实验数据
datasets.decision: 中文公开来源，当前不纳入独立跨设备气体识别实验
datasets.reason: 公开目录可确认包含H2、CO、CO2测试以及MEMS阵列半导体CO精度/湿度文件，CO目录出现9、10、12号通道和1、10、100、500 ppm等浓度；但元数据未证明这些通道是独立电子鼻设备，也未证明存在同协议CO缺失或其他气体类别配对。下载还需登录，且大包混有模拟、工艺和CAD资料。

conclusion: No independent public dataset screened here simultaneously establishes CO identity, a new device, and high-to-low concentration transfer with reliable gas labels. Do not treat the negative cross-board stress or the confounded 7.8 GB archive as positive validation.

related_work_screening.name: Rapid Detection of Mixed Gases from Lithium Battery Thermal Runaway Based on ISA-LSTM-TCN
related_work_screening.relevance: 2026 paper uses the same UCI Twin archive for external assessment with augmentation and discusses low-concentration response; it does not establish the identical leave-one-device-out high-to-low protocol. Check protocol before novelty wording.

related_work_screening.name: A comprehensive gas recognition algorithm with label-free drift compensation based on domain adversarial network
related_work_screening.relevance: Prior domain adaptation and calibration-transfer method also evaluates UCI Twin; using CNN on Twin is not by itself new.

related_work_screening.name: Global calibration models for temperature-modulated metal oxide gas sensors (2022)
related_work_screening.relevance: Six FIS sensor replicas, low CO with humidity; pooled cross-unit calibration and few-target-sample baselines are prior art.

related_work_screening.name: An Optimized Generic Framework for Multi-Gas Classification in Electronic Nose Applications (2026)
related_work_screening.relevance: The nine-array and mixture benchmarks reuse UCI 251 and UCI 322, respectively, and add no independent CO mixture measurements.

related_work_screening.name: A Dual-Model Framework with Gramian Angular Field and Multi-Branch Spatiotemporal Attention (2026)
related_work_screening.relevance: Reuses UCI 309, 487, and Twin for mixed gas, low CO, and cross-device claims. Its Dataset IV has NO2/SO2/benzene and no CO. Its reported fivefold random split on UCI 309 cannot be equated to held-device high-to-low validation.

related_work_screening.name: Arendes et al. 2024, Transfer Learning Between Two Different Datasets of MOS Gas Sensors
related_work_screening.relevance: Prior art for deep-learning calibration transfer across environmental scenarios; conference abstract reports 6 h target calibration RMSE 16.4 ppb versus 80 h 14.8 ppb, but does not provide a new public held-device CO/no-CO mixture test set.

related_work_screening.name: Wang et al. 2024, Graph-Driven Models for Gas Mixture Identification and Concentration Estimation
related_work_screening.relevance: Chinese-led comparison reuses UCI dynamic gas mixtures for CO/ethylene versus methane/ethylene, plus one new H2/ethylene array; confirms this UCI family is heavily used and does not create independent device evidence.

related_work_screening.name: Kang et al. 2022, High Accuracy Real-Time Multi-Gas Identification by a Batch-Uniform Gas Sensor Array and Deep Learning Algorithm
related_work_screening.relevance: CNN recognition of CO, NH3, NO2, CH4 and acetone from batch-uniform array is established; any new claim must target the high-to-low held-device mechanism with credible independent evaluation.

related_work_screening.name: MDFE-Net: A Meta-Learning Driven Dual-Branch Feature Extraction Network for E-Nose Sensor Drift Adaptation (2026)
related_work_screening.relevance: Uses the UCI Twin benchmark for cross-device evaluation and reports 97.89% accuracy. This establishes that cross-device deep learning on Twin is not new. Available descriptions train with the ordinary concentration coverage; they do not establish the stricter source-high/target-low split used here.

related_work_screening.name: Are Time-Series Foundation Models Ready for E-Nose Data? (2026)
related_work_screening.relevance: Holds out B1-B4 in turn but trains on all concentration levels of the remaining devices. Its best reported weighted F1 is 0.876, so it is a useful protocol contrast, not a directly comparable score to the frozen high-to-low task.

related_work_screening.name: A Dual-Model Framework with Gramian Angular Field and Spatio-Temporal Attention (2026)
related_work_screening.relevance: Uses UCI Twin with an 8:1:1 sample split after sliding-window expansion, not a held-device high-to-low split. The reported perfect classification therefore does not answer the same deployment question and should not be used as a numerical baseline for this task.
